title: On-ramp: pay by card, settle in crypto
description: How the AGI network takes card payments in ordinary currency while deals settle in crypto.

blocks.text: You pay by card in euros or dollars, as in any shop. A licensed exchange provider sells you USDT at the current rate, and the amount goes straight to your project's account. You do not need to buy crypto in advance.

The payment agent issues an invoice in your currency. You pay it by card in the exchange provider's window; the provider buys USDT and credits it to the project account. In the «Strand» story Anna paid €139.50 and the project received 150 USDT.

Identity checks and the regulator's requirements are handled by the exchange provider, which holds the licence and runs its own procedure. Your card details stay with the provider; the Fractera node neither receives nor stores them.
A contractor paid in USDT can sell it with the same provider and receive money on a card in their own currency.

blocks.title: Where it sits among the protocols

blocks.text: The exchange goes through an external service and the blockchain, so it is the M2M protocol: every operation is written to the blockchain.
